# `dump --stage checked` prints a struct constraint, one naming another
# parameter of its list, and a method on a generic struct back so the dump
# checks again and is a fixed point.
#
# A method's receiver list was dropped, `func Box.get()`, which named no type
# and left `this` undefined in the dump.

sngl dump --stage checked app.sngl
cp stdout first.sngl
sngl check first.sngl
sngl dump --stage checked first.sngl
cp stdout second.sngl
cmp first.sngl second.sngl

grep 'func Box\[T\]\.get\(\)' first.sngl
grep 'func Keyed\[A, B\]\.keyOf\(\)' first.sngl
grep 'func valueOf\[T any, U struct \{' first.sngl

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Box[T any] {
    value T
}

func Box[T].get() => this.value

struct Cell {
    value int
}

func valueOf[T any, U struct {
    value T
}](u U) => u.value

struct Entry {
    key string
}

struct Keyed[K any, V struct {
    key K
}] {
    item V
}

func Keyed[A, B].keyOf() => this.item.key

func testRoundTrip(t Test) {
    var b = Box[int]{value=3}
    var k = Keyed[string, Entry]{item=Entry{key="k"}}
    t.assert(b.get() == 3 && valueOf(Cell{value=1}) == 1 && k.keyOf() == "k")
}

window {
    text(value="x")
}
